response.overview: Dreams gathered from the public — visions and nightmares, images and sounds submitted through an open online call — become the raw material for a passage through the states of sleep and consciousness. The fragments are assembled into stylised three-dimensional dreamscapes, at once familiar and surreal, where music meets live images and the boundary between waking life and dreaming dissolves in real time. The title refers to the last of the five sleep cycles, the dreaming phase just before waking, when elements of daily life resurface as a parallel reality.
response.title: Rapid Eye Movement
